name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (game function; domain=battle physical-combat). Descriptor accurately reflects 'execute one physical attack and compute+apply its damage', which is the function's umbrella role (it also rolls hit/crit/poison, applies HP, and stages kill XP, all subordinate to executing the attack). No address residue; trailing tokens are semantic words, not hex. Verified against decompile, assembly, and the sole caller fd2_animate_combat_hit_with_hp_drain.
purpose: Core physical-combat resolver: for one hit of attacker against defender, gather stats, apply terrain AP/DP modifiers, roll hit/crit/poison via the shared RNG, compute and apply damage to defender HP, and stage the kill-XP credit. Returns defender's HP after the hit.
logic_summary: Indexes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr by attacker_idx/defender_idx (80-byte runtime_char). Reads AP +0x48, DP +0x4A, HP_cur +0x40, HP_max +0x42, attacker HIT(+0x4C), defender EV(+0x4E), job_id +0x20, level +0x21. Resolves the equipped weapon (fd2_find_equipped_item_by_kind kind=0 -> fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id -> fd2_get_item_effect_entry): weapon_class=entry[9], weapon_elem=entry[10]. Terrain: for each side not status-immune (fd2_check_char_status_immunity), reads the tile at its (x,y) (fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos) and adds stat*pct/100 using MV table @0x51A12 (AP) / DEF table @0x51A2A (DP), index = tile_attr_buf[5]. base_crit = data_fd2_battle_job_crit_rate_table[job_id-1]; class 4 -> total_crit=base_crit+weapon_elem; class 2 -> roll RNG, if rng%100<weapon_elem then second RNG sets defender[+0x25]=rng%4+2 (poison 2..5) and green palette flash. Hit roll: RNG, HIT iff rng%100 < (HIT-EV) -> set hit/miss flag=0, RNG crit roll: if rng%100<total_crit white flash and DP/=2; damage=(AP-DP)*9/10 clamped>=0, if damage/9!=0 add RNG%(damage/9) jitter; HP_cur=max(0,HP_cur-damage). Writes HP_cur back to +0x40. XP: only if attacker.team(+6)==TEAM_PLAYER(2) and defender portrait(+7)>=0x44, enemy=fd2_get_enemy_data_entry(portrait-0x44); mid-tier jobs 9..24 or char_id 0x1C add +0x1E to attacker level (divisor); pending_xp=enemy[9]*def_level/atk_level, then if defender survived *damage/HP_max. Leading __CHK(0x58,...) is the Watcom stack/bounds-check CRT intrinsic, not game logic. The Ghidra decompiler mis-folded the RNG return into the crit variable in 4 spots; the assembly-true predicates are rng%100<weapon_elem (poison hit), rng%4+2 (poison duration, NOT (rng/4)%4), rng%100<(HIT-EV) (hit), rng%100<total_crit (crit), rng%(damage/9) (jitter).

params.name: attacker_idx
params.semantics: Index into the runtime_char array of the attacking combatant. Used as data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[attacker_idx] to read AP/HIT/job/level/team/char_id and to find the equipped weapon; also passed to fd2_check_char_status_immunity / fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos for the attacker's terrain bonus.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name already attacker_idx (ordinal 0, needs_rename=false) and matches the src declaration. Clear semantic name, no address residue; accurately denotes the attacker's runtime_char index.

params.name: defender_idx
params.semantics: Index into the runtime_char array of the defending combatant. Used as data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[defender_idx] to read DP/EV/HP_cur/HP_max/level/portrait, to apply poison and damage (write HP +0x40), and for the defender's terrain DP bonus.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name already defender_idx (ordinal 1, needs_rename=false) and matches the src declaration. Clear semantic name, no address residue; accurately denotes the defender's runtime_char index.

returns.semantics: Defender's HP after the hit is applied (0..HP_max). 0 means the defender was killed by this hit. The sole caller fd2_animate_combat_hit_with_hp_drain uses the return to drive the HP-drain animation and death handling; the hit/miss outcome itself is communicated out-of-band via data_fd2_battle_last_hit_or_miss_flag.

comment_original_issue: src comment was accurate but minimal (3 lines: 'CORE PHYSICAL COMBAT FORMULA', 'verified against assembly', 'decompiler had 4 bugs'). It correctly flagged the decompiler bugs but neither summarized the actual formula nor enumerated which 4 spots were wrong, so a reader of battle.c could not understand the combat math or guard against reintroducing the decompiler's RNG-folding errors.
notes: Comment-only refine (no logic touched). Assembly @0x1ECC7 fully verified the 4 decompiler RNG-folding bugs: (1) poison-hit at 0x1ee32-0x1ee47 uses rng%100<weapon_elem (decompiler showed base_crit%100); (2) poison duration at 0x1ee49-0x1ee5d is a SECOND rng then rng%4+2 -> defender[+0x25] (range 2..5; decompiler showed 2+(rng/4)%4); (3) hit roll at 0x1eebc-0x1eed7 uses rng%100<(HIT-EV) and crit roll at 0x1eee4-0x1eef9 uses rng%100<total_crit (decompiler reused base_crit_div_100/dx_diff); (4) damage jitter at 0x1efa7-0x1efb5 is rng%(damage/9) (decompiler showed (damage/9)%jitter_div). src already encodes all 4 correctly. Verdict crit-DP-halving / damage*9/10 / HP clamp all match assembly and the official strategy-guide formula (introductions.htm: actual damage = max*0.9 .. max-1; hit rate = HIT-EV%; XP = (dmgHP/totalHP)*(deflvl*per-lvl-xp)*(deflvl/atklvl)). Updated the Ghidra plate to correct its poison-duration line (was decompiler-bugged) and to annotate the hit/crit predicates as assembly-true rng%100; preserved the plate's detailed structure. Names: function and both params already convention-compliant with no address residue -> all keep, no Stage-2 rename needed. No equivalence/logic issues found.
